name: demuxed_history_64_rank8_side2048
architecture: Sequential RWKV residual update followed by KS2 decoder residual update. Shared 96D main stream plus 2048D decoder-only side stream. Each decoder reads separate post-attention and post-FFN 96D residual states from all previous layers. Fixed Hadamard input mux and output demux at every decoder; learned per-output demux gains.
rwkv: Original learned dense projections and controllers.
note: This is the baseline going forward. Historical runners and defaults remain intact to preserve previous experiments.
